items.summary: Move to drop Trump ally and prominent abortion opponent comes a day before key Senate health committee vote The White House has dropped its nomination of Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration, a White House official told the Guardian. Donald Trump nominated Overton – a physician and prominent abortion opponent – in August. Overton has spent most of her professional career working directly for Trump or conservative groups aligned with his agenda. Her nomination in August was seen as a move to bring a stabilizing Trump loyalist to the agency after a tumultous year under Trump’s first FDA commissioner, Marty Makary. Continue reading...

items.summary: England’s exam regulator says those caught using AI or smart glasses face disqualification from GCSEs and A-levels Students in England could suffer “life-altering” penalties if they are caught relying on AI or smart glasses to cheat, England’s qualifications regulator has said. The head of Ofqual , Ian Bauckham, said students could be disqualified from GCSEs, A-levels and other qualifications if they tried to use AI in assessed coursework, and called for retailers to be barred from marketing wearable technology for exam cheating.
